staticChecks.detail: Paths, script placement, property shapes and duplicate instances checked.

Expert refinement retains authored paths, stations, terraces, beacon, arch and strict resolver; six main upright crystal bodies plus two shards each reduce the manifest to 42 world entries. Native composition, legibility and walkability remain pending.

Spawn is placed at (0,1,18), Node01 at (-6,1.7,10), SellStation at (-16,1.5,10), and UpgradeStation at (14,1.5,10), all connected by broad pale paths and reachable without jumping. Station SurfaceGui labels provide readable SELL and UPGRADES silhouettes, while cyan/violet crystals and contrasting station colors distinguish the first actions in the authored scene.

The shared Contract module exports the exact approved economy, interaction, cooldown, node, respawn, and goal constants. Action and Feedback are declared once as RemoteEvents inside the shared ReplicatedStorage namespace.

Economy.apply clamps harvest yield to free capacity and shared node stock. Game validates living characters, known node IDs, proximity, cooldowns and shared stock, then decrements stock without allowing negative values and schedules a six-second refill with dimmed authored crystal parts.
Selling converts the entire server-owned Carry value at Contract.SELL_VALUE, clears the bag, increments TotalSold and rejects empty sales without mutation.
Power and capacity are independent level-two tracks using Contract prices and benefits. Purchases validate affordability and maximum level, deduct coins once, and update harvest yield or capacity.

GoalComplete is set only when the individual player's TotalSold reaches 40 and both upgrade levels reach one. The server emits one goal feedback event when the state flips while preserving ordinary play.

Game accepts only harvest, sell, upgradePower and upgradeCapacity, validates argument count, known node IDs, living characters, distance, cooldowns and server-owned state. Client-provided amounts, prices and rewards are not accepted.

Existing and newly joined players receive independent session state and all seven replicated attributes. Character respawns do not reset state, PlayerRemoving clears per-player state and cooldowns, and no persistence, monetization, HTTP, numeric require or uploaded asset dependency is used.

HUD.mount creates exactly one replaceable CrystalHollowHUD ScreenGui with the required named labels and four button handles. The returned render function consumes real supplied state snapshots, updates carry, coins, both upgrade tracks, prices, benefits, goal progress and contextual hints, and applies disabled-looking availability states for a compact responsive 340-stud panel suitable for narrow viewports. The returned toast and destroy functions remain scoped to this HUD instance.

Goal feedback now marks the local celebration as consumed when the server goal event arrives, preventing the replicated GoalComplete attribute callback from replaying the celebration. Sell feedback now visibly emphasizes CoinsLabel with a temporary color and size tween; all effects remain local and are cleaned up by Feedback.destroy.

changes: Economy increments TotalSold on successful sales; upgrades return amount zero.
HUD retains toasts for three seconds across render calls; depleted-node hint is reachable; Roblox GUI inset respected.
Controller deduplicates goal celebration for either attribute/event order; Game goal message omits the harvest-only position field.
Upright primary crystal WedgeParts replace flat dark bases; each keeps two decorative shards. World resolver counts two children plus main crystal. Coverage describes the refined manifest.
Identity-transformed upright station signs use Back faces toward spawn, instead of thin Top faces.
limitations: Offline Luau with mocked Roblox UI values/Instances is not Studio execution or visual verification.

Original model review and protected tests are retained unchanged as evidence. Their child-shard >=3 assertion counts three children plus a main crystal, whereas the refined scene has three visible pieces total; it must not be presented as passing unchanged.
Source review and mocked UI do not prove native first-minute timing, geometry walkability, network replication, or screenshot quality.
